confidence_notes: Meals, beer, and cappuccino use citywide data closest to July (May 2026); lodging is a holistic seasonal estimate. Cocktail and wine prices are inferred from the local draft-beer price, so venue mix and July tourism demand add uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: No substitution city used: food anchors use Playa del Carmen citywide averages, while lodging estimates reflect the Riviera Maya coastal resort market.
